verdict.rationale: OpenCode has no dedicated bulk-operation feature. It offers building blocks for batching work: parallel multi-session agents on the same project, non-interactive `opencode run` for scripting, a programmatic SDK and headless server for driving many tasks, and `--auto` approval for unattended runs. Bulk work is therefore achievable only by orchestrating these pieces yourself. Missing for 10: a native batch/bulk command for applying one operation across many items, documented bulk workflows or examples, and hands-on corroboration of large-scale batch use.
